zh-Hans: 远征军随行的法力源头。前沿中点是源口，魔网连线从这里出发。
en: The expedition's travelling mana source. The middle of its front edge is the wellhead, where Mana Web links begin.

zh-Hans: 魔网节点。覆盖周围 2 格，同一条格线上 3 格内的节点自动连线。
en: A Mana Web node. Covers 2 tiles around it and links to nodes within 3 tiles on the same grid line.

zh-Hans: 骑着战马的重甲骑士，顶在前排吸收伤害，专克轻装单位。
en: An armoured knight on a warhorse who holds the front line and soaks up damage. Strong against light units.

zh-Hans: 身手敏捷的游侠，突进去切掉敌方远程单位。
en: A nimble ranger who dashes in to cut down enemy ranged units.

zh-Hans: 密集的弩箭火网，专门射落狮鹫和怨灵。
en: A dense hail of crossbow bolts, built to shoot down griffins and wraiths.

zh-Hans: 超远射程的奥术轰击，自身法力有限，必须待在魔网覆盖内。
en: Arcane bombardment from extreme range. Her own mana is limited, so she must stay inside Mana Web coverage.

zh-Hans: 骑狮鹫的空中骑士，可以离网 10 秒绕后，优先攻击魔网节点和远程单位。
en: A knight of the skies on griffin-back. Can leave the web for 10 seconds to flank, and goes for Mana Web nodes and ranged units first.

zh-Hans: 选择落点，1 秒后对范围内敌人造成大量伤害
en: Choose a point. After 1 second, enemies in the area take heavy damage.
Restores half of every ally's shield.

zh-Hans: 灯塔城外的第一颗法力水晶被一小队食尸鬼占着。把它们赶走。
en: A small band of ghouls holds the first Mana Crystal outside Lighthaven. Drive them off.

zh-Hans: 怨灵专门撕咬魔网连线。看好你的法力水晶。
en: Wraiths go straight for Mana Web links. Keep an eye on your Mana Crystals.

zh-Hans: 亡灵在碎裂的水晶上垒起了毒雾骨塔。它的法力靠后方的骨碑补充。
en: The undead have raised Miasma Bone Towers on shattered crystals. Bone Obelisks in the rear keep them fed with mana.

zh-Hans: 一排憎恶堵住了道路。它们皮糙肉厚，怕奥术法师和狮鹫骑士。
en: A row of abominations blocks the road. They're thick-skinned, but they fear Arcane Mages and Griffin Knights.

zh-Hans: 要塞外围的墓园，三座骨碑连着骨塔。
en: A graveyard on the fortress outskirts, where three Bone Obelisks feed the bone towers.

zh-Hans: 这群亡灵吸饱了水晶里的法力，比普通个体强得多（★2）。
en: These undead have glutted themselves on crystal mana and are far stronger than usual (★2).

zh-Hans: 一头缝合巨怪带着护卫在水晶间游荡。它每第 4 次攻击是一记重击。
en: A Stitched Colossus roams between the crystals with an escort. Every 4th attack is a crushing blow.
Elite: Ambush on the Old Battlefield

zh-Hans: 古战场的坟堆里埋伏着一队亡灵，后方有缝合巨怪压阵。
en: Undead lie in wait among the barrows of an old battlefield, with a Stitched Colossus holding the rear.

zh-Hans: 亡灵用断线日倒下的守军尸骨和碎水晶垒成了一座要塞。要塞不会移动，但骨炮覆盖我方前两排，每第 3 次攻击是一轮重炮齐射。
en: The undead built this fortress from shattered crystals and the bones of the defenders who fell on Severance Day. It cannot move, but its bone cannons cover our first two rows, and every 3rd attack is a full barrage.

zh-Hans:
雷恩爵士：断线日之后，灯塔城的源晶是星线最末端还亮着的光。从这里往外，每一颗水晶都被亡灵吸干了。

指挥官，晨星远征军现在只有三个人。但每夺回一颗水晶，就能把一座城邦重新连回星线，也能招募那里的勇士。

骸骨要塞在这片行省的尽头。拿下它，边境行省的星线就通了。
en:
Sir Rayne: Since Severance Day, Lighthaven's source crystal has been the last light still burning at the far end of the Starline. Beyond it, every crystal has been drained by the undead.

Commander, the Morning Star Expedition is only three strong. But each crystal we take back reconnects a city-state to the Starline, and lets us recruit its champions.

The Ossuary Fortress stands at the far edge of this province. Take it, and the Starline runs through the Border Provinces again.

zh-Hans:
诺娃：骸骨要塞的死气散了。边境行省的星线……重新亮了起来。

雷恩爵士：干得漂亮，指挥官。三座边境城邦已经连回灯塔城。下一站是王国腹地。

（第二幕“王国腹地”正在开发中）
en:
Nova: The death-mist over the Ossuary Fortress is gone. The Starline across the Border Provinces... it's shining again.

Sir Rayne: Well done, Commander. Three border city-states are linked to Lighthaven once more. Next stop: the Kingdom's Heartland.

(Act II, "The Heartland", is in development)

zh-Hans: 雷恩爵士：远征军撤回灯塔城。星线还在那里，亡灵也还在那里。我们还会回去的。
en: Sir Rayne: The expedition falls back to Lighthaven. The Starline is still out there, and so are the undead. We'll be back.
